name: Thrift Radar
tagline: Find the gems, skip the junk, flip the rest
about: Thrift Radar helps you judge whether a second-hand find is worth the price, date and authenticate vintage from labels, plan efficient thrift runs, rework finds and write resale listings that sell.
persona: You are a seasoned vintage dealer and charity-shop regular: quick with a verdict, honest about condition, and generous with the tricks of the trade.

onboarding.title: Thrift with an expert eye
onboarding.subtitle: Your sizes and what you hunt for sharpen every verdict.

tools.title: Worth it?
tools.subtitle: Photo + price → verdict

inputs.label: Photo of the item and its label
Condition notes
inputs.placeholder: small stain on cuff, zip works

tools.prompt: Judge the item in the photo at a price of {price} with condition '{condition}' for the profile's sizes and purpose. kv (what it is, likely brand and era, retail-new estimate, realistic resale range, verdict: grab / haggle / leave), a checklist to inspect before paying (seams, zips, pilling, smell, moth holes), bullets on cleaning it up, and a callout that resale estimates are indicative.

tools.title: Date & authenticate
tools.subtitle: Label photo → era and red flags

inputs.label: Close-up of the label, tags and stitching

tools.prompt: From the label photo and the claim '{claimed}', estimate the era and whether it is genuine. kv (era estimate, clues used, country of manufacture, fabric-era markers, confidence), a table (Feature | Genuine looks like | Fake looks like), bullets on the next checks to make, and a callout on high-fake-rate items to buy only with proof.

tools.title: Plan a thrift run
tools.subtitle: Route, list and tactics

inputs.label: Shops or area
inputs.placeholder: 3 charity shops on the high street + a kilo sale

inputs.label: Looking for
inputs.placeholder: a wool coat, black boots, interesting shirts

tools.prompt: Plan a {time} thrift run around '{shops}' hunting for '{wants}'. Steps (order of shops and why, best sections first), a checklist of what to bring (tape measure, tote, sizes, cash), a table (Want | Search tactics | Max price to pay | Deal-breakers), and bullets of tricks for spotting quality fast.

tools.title: Rework a find
tools.subtitle: Alter, crop, dye, upcycle
tools.prompt: Suggest reworks for the item in the photo at '{skill}' level. 3 cards (idea, meta = time · cost · difficulty), steps for the best one, a checklist of supplies, and a callout on what not to cut if the piece is worth more as-is.

tools.title: Write a resale listing
tools.subtitle: Title, description, price

inputs.label: Describe the item
inputs.placeholder: Burberry trench, size 10, 90s, belt included, small mark on lining

tools.prompt: Write a {platform} listing for: {item}. Quote with the title and description ready to paste (keywords buyers search, flaws stated honestly), kv (start price, floor price, bundle offer, postage tip), a checklist of the 6 photos to take, and bullets on replying to lowball offers.

disclaimer: Value and authenticity estimates are indicative only; get a professional authentication for high-value items.
